(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((top-color (at g 0 0))
                  (bottom-color (at g (- h 1) 0))
                  (left-color (at g 0 0))
                  (right-color (at g 0 (- w 1)))
                  (top-bottom? (and
                                 (!= top-color 0)
                                 (!= bottom-color 0)
                                 (for/and ((c (range 0 w))) (= (at g 0 c) top-color))
                                 (for/and ((c (range 0 w)))
                                          (= (at g (- h 1) c) bottom-color))))
                  (left-right? (and
                                 (!= left-color 0)
                                 (!= right-color 0)
                                 (for/and ((r (range 0 h))) (= (at g r 0) left-color))
                                 (for/and ((r (range 0 h)))
                                          (= (at g r (- w 1)) right-color)))))
             (cond
               (top-bottom? (reduce (lambda (acc p)
                                      (let* ((r (fst p))
                                             (c (snd p))
                                             (nr (if (< (* 2 r) h) (- r 1) (+ r 1)))
                                             (color (if (< (* 2 r) h)
                                                        top-color
                                                        bottom-color)))
                                        (if (in-bounds? nr c h w)
                                            (set-cell acc nr c color)
                                            acc)))
                                    g
                                    (find-color g 1)))
               (left-right? (reduce (lambda (acc p)
                                      (let* ((r (fst p))
                                             (c (snd p))
                                             (nc (if (< (* 2 c) w) (- c 1) (+ c 1)))
                                             (color (if (< (* 2 c) w)
                                                        left-color
                                                        right-color)))
                                        (if (in-bounds? r nc h w)
                                            (set-cell acc r nc color)
                                            acc)))
                                    g
                                    (find-color g 1)))
               (else g))))))

(rule! (lambda (g)
  (define (project input)
    (let* ((h (rows input))
           (w (cols input))
           (top-color (at input 0 0))
           (bottom-color (at input (- h 1) 0))
           (left-color (at input 0 0))
           (right-color (at input 0 (- w 1)))
           (top-bottom? (and
                          (!= top-color 0)
                          (!= bottom-color 0)
                          (for/and ((c (range 0 w))) (= (at input 0 c) top-color))
                          (for/and ((c (range 0 w)))
                                   (= (at input (- h 1) c) bottom-color))))
           (left-right? (and
                          (!= left-color 0)
                          (!= right-color 0)
                          (for/and ((r (range 0 h))) (= (at input r 0) left-color))
                          (for/and ((r (range 0 h)))
                                   (= (at input r (- w 1)) right-color)))))
      (cond
        (top-bottom? (reduce (lambda (acc p)
                               (let* ((r (fst p))
                                      (c (snd p))
                                      (nr (if (< (* 2 r) h) (- r 1) (+ r 1)))
                                      (color (if (< (* 2 r) h)
                                                 top-color
                                                 bottom-color)))
                                 (if (in-bounds? nr c h w)
                                     (set-cell acc nr c color)
                                     acc)))
                             input
                             (find-color input 1)))
        (left-right? (reduce (lambda (acc p)
                               (let* ((r (fst p))
                                      (c (snd p))
                                      (nc (if (< (* 2 c) w) (- c 1) (+ c 1)))
                                      (color (if (< (* 2 c) w)
                                                 left-color
                                                 right-color)))
                                 (if (in-bounds? r nc h w)
                                     (set-cell acc r nc color)
                                     acc)))
                             input
                             (find-color input 1)))
        (else input))))
  (define (better-record? a b)
    (cond
      ((> (first a) (first b)) #t)
      ((< (first a) (first b)) #f)
      ((> (second a) (second b)) #t)
      ((< (second a) (second b)) #f)
      ((< (third a) (third b)) #t)
      ((> (third a) (third b)) #f)
      (else (< (list-ref a 6) (list-ref b 6)))))
  (define (bridge input projected horizontal? first-color second-color)
    (let* ((h (rows input))
           (w (cols input))
           (axis-extent (if horizontal? h w))
           (lane-extent (if horizontal? w h))
           (record-for-line
             (lambda (line color side-order)
               (let* ((positions
                        (filter
                          (lambda (lane)
                            (let ((r (if horizontal? line lane))
                                  (c (if horizontal? lane line)))
                              (and (= (at input r c) 0)
                                   (= (at projected r c) color))))
                          (range 0 lane-extent))))
                 (if (>= (length positions) 2)
                     (let* ((lo (apply min positions))
                            (hi (apply max positions)))
                       (list (length positions) (+ 1 (- hi lo))
                             line color lo hi side-order))
                     (list)))))
           (records
             (filter
               (lambda (record) (not (empty? record)))
               (apply append
                 (for/list ((line (range 1 (- axis-extent 1))))
                   (list (record-for-line line first-color 0)
                         (record-for-line line second-color 1)))))))
      (if (empty? records)
          projected
          (let* ((winner (first (sort records better-record?)))
                 (line (third winner))
                 (color (list-ref winner 3))
                 (lo (list-ref winner 4))
                 (hi (list-ref winner 5)))
            (for/fold ((out projected)) ((lane (range lo (+ hi 1))))
              (if horizontal?
                  (set-cell out line lane color)
                  (set-cell out lane line color)))))))
  (let* ((h (rows g))
         (w (cols g))
         (top-color (at g 0 0))
         (bottom-color (at g (- h 1) 0))
         (left-color (at g 0 0))
         (right-color (at g 0 (- w 1)))
         (top-bottom? (and
                        (!= top-color 0)
                        (!= bottom-color 0)
                        (for/and ((c (range 0 w))) (= (at g 0 c) top-color))
                        (for/and ((c (range 0 w)))
                                 (= (at g (- h 1) c) bottom-color))))
         (projected (project g)))
    (if top-bottom?
        (bridge g projected #t top-color bottom-color)
        (bridge g projected #f left-color right-color)))))
